local_context.value: Census QuickFacts for Port Royal town shows 10.6% of residents 65 or older (the QuickFacts page blocked the fetch tool, so the figure was read from the QuickFacts search result; re-confirm in a browser); Beaufort County overall: 28.4% were 65+ in 2020. Historic centre is the Old Village; the 1893 Sea Islands Hurricane destroyed much of the local phosphate industry; 4,764 housing units at the 2020 census (13.8% vacant); the town is on Port Royal Island at Port Royal Sound.

neighborhoods.value: Old Village (historic centre; Paris Avenue main commercial street); Mossy Creek (low-density residential north of Old Village); Preserve at Port Royal (apartments between the two).
